payload.claim: The comment cites `saffron/cli.py:1024-1025` as the location of `_stack_revise`'s `base:` line and snapshot sentence, but those lines (1024-1025) are actually the `git_mirror.export_saffron_dir(...)` call inside `_stack_revise`.
